## 型

### Instant

```emela
opaque type Instant
```

## 値

### from_unix_milliseconds

```emela
fn from_unix_milliseconds(ms: Int64) -> Instant
```

Negative values are before the epoch.

### to_unix_milliseconds

```emela
fn to_unix_milliseconds(t: Instant) -> Int64
```

### add

```emela
fn add(t: Instant, d: Duration) -> Instant
```

Earlier if `d` is negative.

### subtract

```emela
fn subtract(t: Instant, d: Duration) -> Instant
```

### since

```emela
fn since(t: Instant, earlier: Instant) -> Duration
```

The duration from `earlier` to `t`; negative if `earlier` is later.
Reads as `now.since(start)`.

### to_string

```emela
fn to_string(t: Instant) -> String
```

UTC in ISO 8601 (`2026-10-12T03:04:05.678Z`). Same format as JS `Date.prototype.toISOString`:
years outside 0 to 9999 are written with a sign and six digits (`+010000`, `-000001`).
